label: Town of Swanton
header:
# Town of Swanton municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 23; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

Town of Swanton, 2025 Town Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' page (town/village website): Brian Savage held the moderator's one-year term expiring in 2026; the 2026 winner is published in no official source in hand, so no membership is created
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Town of Swanton official website, Town Clerk & Treasurer page: Cathy L. Fournier is the Town Clerk; the page notes the Clerk also serves as the Town Treasurer

Town of Swanton, Warning for the 2026 annual town meeting, signed January 2026 (town/village website): presents a combined 'Town Clerk & Treasurer' as one three-year office; modeled as two posts with one holder (the Hardwick combined-office precedent)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Cathy Fournier as Swanton's Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Cathy Fournier as Swanton's Town Clerk
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Town of Swanton official website, Town Clerk & Treasurer page: Cathy L. Fournier holds both offices
Town of Swanton, Warning for the 2026 annual town meeting, signed January 2026 (town/village website): presents a combined 'Town Clerk & Treasurer' as one three-year office
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Cathy Fournier as Swanton's Town Treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): names Cathy Fournier as Swanton's Town Treasurer
Town of Swanton official website, Selectboard page: names Joel Clark (Chair), Nicholas Brosseau (Vice Chair), Nicole Draper, Earl Fournier, and Ronald Underwood

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Joel Clark (Chair), Nicholas Brosseau (Vice Chair), Nicole Draper, Earl Fournier, and Ronald Underwood for Swanton's five-member board

Town of Swanton, Warning for the 2026 annual town meeting, signed January 2026 (town/village website): the January 2026 signature block still shows Steven J. Bourgeois, whose three-year seat stood in 2026; he is absent from the current board and is not seated
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect three listers on staggered three-year terms

Town of Swanton, 2025 Town Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' page (town/village website): David Horton (term to 2027) and Kevin Nichols (to 2028); Amy Giroux's seat expired in 2026 and its outcome is published in no official source in hand
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect auditors (three, staggered terms) unless the office is eliminated

Town of Swanton, 2025 Town Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' page (town/village website): Joyce Bombardier (term to 2027) and Diane Larocque (to 2028); Amy Giroux's seat expired in 2026 and its outcome is published in no official source in hand

Town of Swanton, 2025 Town Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' page (town/village website): Nicholas A. Brosseau (term to 2027) and Brian K. Savage (to 2028); Cody Hemenway's seat stood in 2026 and its outcome is published in no official source in hand
Town of Swanton official website, Cemetery Commission page: names Nicholas Brosseau, John Kaczkowski, Brian Savage, and Macy Lavoie-Dupont as the current commissioners

Town of Swanton, 2025 Town Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' page (town/village website): the report's roster also carried Cody Hemenway with a term to 2029; he is absent from the current commission page and is not seated

Town of Swanton, 2025 Town Report, 'ELECTED TOWN OFFICERS' page (town/village website): Kathy Kneebone (term to 2027), Sarah Garvey (to 2028), Richard Kelly (to 2029), and Bianca Braman (to 2030); Rebecca Rupp's seat expired in 2026 and its outcome is published in no official source in hand

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists fifteen Town of Swanton justices of the peace: Tamar Bouchard, Randy Brock, Nicholas A. Brosseau, Donald Collins, Edward Daniel, Stephanie Gagne, Steven D. Pike, Pamela Pouliot, Jeffery 'Jeff' Raleigh, Joseph 'Joe' Raleigh, Brian Savage, Alan Shannon, Neal Speer, Matthew E. Walker, and Suzanne Washburn. Village of Swanton residents vote in this election, so the village has no justice of the peace post of its own
